title: AI Gender Bias, Disparities, and Fairness: Does Training Data Matter?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned language models (BERT and GPT-3.5) on male, female, and mixed-gender training datasets of student-written responses. Bias and fairness are measured using three statistical techniques: paired t-tests to assess scoring accuracy differences, Mean Score Gaps (MSG) to determine gender disparity compared to human graders, and Equalized Odds (EO) to assess the equality of true and false positive rates across genders.
